answer: Here is one concrete wall: Elevated brewmaster registration with brewers guild attestation. It works because a registration the guild renews after brew audits, and the hollow it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a registration the guild renews after brew audits is something they already have; the ridge falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the gale for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
